articles.title: Fake document factory dismantled in Spain: around 800 IDs seized
articles.summary: A French-led investigation, supported by Spain and Europol, led to the dismantling of a counterfeit document production facility in Alicante, Spain. The investigation involved the French National Police (Police Nationale/OLTIM) and the Spanish National Police (Policía National/UCRIF).
articles.analysis: El desmantelamiento de la fábrica de documentos en España ilustra la sofisticación de redes transnacionales que operan con impunidad en territorio europeo.
